event: 2025 ILCA 4 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: Hearing No. 66 was heard together with Hearing No. 63 in accordance with RRS 63.(2)(b) since both hearings arose from the same incident.
ITA 222362 was represented by Niccolò Maria Sparagna.
The race committee was represented by Michal Jodlowski (Course Race Officer Area B).
Emauele Montagna (coach of ITA 222362), Max Jablecki (member of the RC), and Jean Bernard Luther (member of the international jury) attended the hearing as observers.
ITA 222362 delivered a first request for redress form using the official notice board at 14:19.
ITA 222362 went to the RC and asked to watch the video of the start of race 11 (F5)
The written request for redress delivered by ITA 222362 states: "I would like to see the video of my start where I was taken "bfd". it was the second general recall."
ITA 222362 delivered a second request for redress form using the official notice board at 15:29.
The Protest Time Limit for the ILCA 4 Boys gold fleet on the 25 June was at 15:45.
The request for redress (Case 63) did not identify the reasons for making it, as required by RRS 61.2. Therefore Hearing No. 63 is invalid, the international jury proceeded with Hearing No. 66.
facts: In race 11 (F5) of the ILCA 4 Boys gold fleet, the black flag was used as the preparatory signal.
Within the last 20 seconds before the starting signal of the race, ITA 222362 was inside the triangle formed by the ends of the line and the first mark, close to the pin end.
ITA 222362 was identified by the race committee on the pin end vessel of the starting line.
The race committee displayed a general recall after the starting signal of the race.
The race committee displayed ITA 222362's sail number on the board before the next warning signal.
ITA 222362 was scored BFD in race 11 (F5).
conclusions: By scoring ITA 222362 who was identified inside the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark during the last minute before the starting signal as BFD, the race committee did not do an improper action or omission. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
decision: Redress is not given to ITA 222362.
